_doc: Manual app-root -> book-article map for headwords the automatic scan cannot reach: the book files these roots under a different weak letter, a shorter/augmented root, a related root, or as a proper-noun sub-entry, so their app key never appears as an isolated spaced headword. Each [page,y] was verified by reading the article on that PDF page. Applied by build_book_pages.py only for keys present in root_counts.json and not already located by the scan. Genuinely-absent keys (the relative/particle set, and ز ي ل / س و ل / ن و ن / ك ب ك ب) are deliberately omitted.
